'''Samaresh Bhattacharya''' (born 1960) is an Indian [[Inorganic chemistry|inorganic]] and [[Organometallic chemistry|organometallic]] chemist and a professor of the department of chemistry at [[Jadavpur University]].<ref name="Department :: Chemistry">{{Cite web |url=http://www.jaduniv.edu.in/view_department.php?deptid=64 |title=Department :: Chemistry |date=2016 |publisher=Jadavpur University}}</ref> He also serves as a dean of the faculty of science at the university.<ref name="International Symposium">{{Cite web |url=http://www.sxccal.edu/announcements/downloads/Forthcoming-Seminar-FOCB-II-2017-24Nov2016.pdf |title=International Symposium |date=2016 |publisher=St. Xavier's College, Kolkata}}</ref> He is known for his studies on the [[Coordination complex|coordination compounds]] of the [[Platinum group|Platinum Group Metals]] with regard to their use in the activation of organic molecules.<ref name="Brief Profile of the Awardee">{{Cite web |url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/Detail.aspx?AID=404 |title=Brief Profile of the Awardee |date=2016 |publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize |access-date=12 November 2016}}</ref> He is an elected fellow of the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]]<ref name="Fellow profile">{{Cite web |url=http://www.ias.ac.in/describe/fellow/Bhattacharya,_Prof._Samaresh |title=Fellow profile |date=2016 |publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences}}</ref> and the West Bengal Academy of Science and Technology.<ref name="WAST fellows">{{Cite web |url=http://iicb.res.in/wast/fellow_wast.pdf |title=WAST fellows |date=2016 |publisher=West Bengal Academy of Science and Technology}}</ref> The [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]], the apex agency of the Government of India for scientific research, awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]], one of the highest Indian science awards, in 2005, for his contributions to chemical sciences.<ref name="View Bhatnagar Awardees">{{cite web | url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/AwardeeList.aspx | title=View Bhatnagar Awardees | publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize | date=2016 | accessdate=12 November 2016}}</ref>

== Biography ==
[[File:Jadavpur University Collage.jpg|thumb|235px|Jadavpur University]]
Samaresh Bhattacharya, born on 24 August 1960 in the Indian state of [[West Bengal]], did his graduate studies at Jadavpur University. After passing his BSc in chemistry in 1978, he continued at the institution to complete his master's degree in 1980.<ref name="Faculty profile">{{Cite web |url=http://www.jaduniv.edu.in/profile.php?uid=18 |title=Faculty profile |date=2016 |publisher=Jadavpur University}}</ref> His doctoral studies were at the [[Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science]] (IACS) from where he secured a PhD in 1986 and joined Jadavpur University as a faculty at the department of chemistry. He has been serving the institution ever since and is a professor of inorganic chemistry and the dean of faculty of science.<ref name="Department :: Chemistry" />

== Legacy and honors ==
Bhattacharya's research has been focused on the [[Platinum group|Platinum Group of Metals]] comprising [[ruthenium]], [[rhodium]], [[palladium]], [[osmium]], [[iridium]], and [[platinum]] and he has studied their uses in activating organic molecules.<ref name="Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners">{{Cite web |url=http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf |title=Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners |date=2016 |publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research}}</ref> He has documented his research in several peer-reviewed articles;<ref name="Browse by Fellow">{{Cite web |url=http://repository.ias.ac.in/view/fellows/Bhattacharya=3ASamaresh=3A=3A.html |title=Browse by Fellow |date=2016 |publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences}}</ref> [[ResearchGate]], an online repository of scientific articles has listed 137 of them.<ref name="On ResearchGate">{{Cite web |url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Samaresh_Bhattacharya2 |title=On ResearchGate |date=2016 }}</ref> He is on the Subject Expert Committee for Chemical Sciences of the ''Fund for Improvement of S&T Infrastructure in Universities and other Higher Educational Institutions'' (FIST Program) constituted by the [[Department of Science and Technology (India)|Department of Science and Technology]].<ref name="FIST Program">{{Cite web |url=http://www.fist-dst.org/html-flies/about-us/OM-FIST-Expert%20Committees-June-2016.pdf |title=FIST Program |date=2016}}</ref> He was a guest editor of the ''Special Issue Dedicated to Acharya [[Prafulla Chandra Ray|P. C. Ray]]'' published by the ''Indian Journal of Chemistry'' - Sec A in 2011.<ref name="Special Issue Dedicated to Acharya P C Ray">{{Cite web |url=http://www.niscair.res.in/ScienceCommunication/sci.asp?a=topframe.htm&b=leftcon.asp&c=ResearchJournals/rejour/ijca/ijca0.asp&d=test1 |title=Special Issue Dedicated to Acharya P C Ray |last=Indian Journal of Chemistry - Sec A |date=2016 |publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research}}</ref> He is a former member of the Sectional Committee for Chemical Sciences of the Executive Council of West Bengal Academy of Science and Technology during 2012–13.<ref name="WAST Executive Council (2013-14)">{{Cite web |url=http://iicb.res.in/wast/present_council.html |title=WAST Executive Council (2013-14) |date=2016 |publisher=West Bengal Academy of Science and Technology}}</ref> He has participated in several symposiums as an invited speaker<ref name="International Symposium" /> and is a member of the National Organizing Committee of the ''Fifth Symposium on Advanced Biological Inorganic Chemistry'' (SABIC-2017), organized by the [[Tata Institute of Fundamental Research]] and scheduled to be held in January 2017.<ref name="National Organizing Committee">{{Cite web |url=http://www.tifr.res.in/~SABIC/about.html |title=National Organizing Committee |publisher=Tata Institute of Fundamental Research}}</ref>

The Council of Scientific and Industrial Research awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize]], one of the highest Indian science awards, in 2005.<ref name="Chemical Sciences">{{cite web | url=http://www.csir.res.in/External/Heads/career/award/BPRIZE/CHEMICAL_SCIENCES.htm | title=Chemical Sciences | publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research | date=2016 | url-status=dead | archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120912012851/http://www.csir.res.in/external/heads/career/award/BPRIZE/CHEMICAL_SCIENCES.htm | archivedate=2012-09-12 }}</ref> He received the Bronze Medal of the [[Chemical Research Society of India]] in 2006<ref name="CRSI Bronze Medal">{{Cite web |url=http://www.crsi.org.in/index.php/crsi-awards/year-1999-2008 |title=CRSI Bronze Medal |date=2016 |publisher=Chemical Research Society of India |access-date=2 December 2016 |archive-date=16 October 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161016123938/http://www.crsi.org.in/index.php/crsi-awards/year-1999-2008 |url-status=dead }}</ref> and he was elected as a fellow by the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]] the same year.<ref name="Fellow profile" /> He is also an elected fellow of the West Bengal Academy of Science and Technology.<ref name="WAST fellows" />
